name: Shadows Over Manston
source:
The Manifest follows the story of an adulterous police officer from a quiet town in Southern USA, injured in the line of duty and embroiled in a series of events that will change his life.

As you are recuperating and not allowed on active duty, you are assigned as a School Resource Officer. You take on the role of a step-in gym teacher for a group of girls who all failed to graduate the prior year.
translation:
《宣言》讲述了一名来自美国南部安静小镇的通奸警察的故事，他在执行任务时受伤，并卷入了一系列将改变他生活的事件。

由于你正在康复且不允许现役，因此你被指派为学校资源官员。你扮演了一群上一年都没能毕业的女孩的体育老师。
